name: Order Sample Compression / Stable Labeled Sample Compression
details: A fixed hypothesis order gives a labeled compression scheme with stable selected keys, and therefore with stable reconstructions. Improper decoded hypotheses are allowed. The conversion preserves the compression width.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: prop:order-stable-installation, using the finite order formulation and fixed tie-breaking on retained keys.
witness_verification: On the full three-cube, OSC is three and stable labeled compression is two. In general the database-owned endpoint values are $n$ and $\lceil n/2\rceil$, so this is strict but not an unbounded-ratio witness. See sync/verify_order_stable_compression.py and the full-cube value proofs.
